pictures.scene: Hubert van Eyck, The Singing Angels — the choir crowded round one lectern with their mouths open on the same note, for the choirmaster a Psalm of the sons of Korah, clap your hands all you peoples
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_singing_angels

pictures.scene: Benjamin West, Joshua Passing the River Jordan with the Ark of the Covenant — the ark carried down into the dry riverbed under a beam of light while the people shout, shout unto God with a voice of triumph, how awesome is the LORD Most High
pictures.name: pd_west_joshua_passing_the_river_jordan_with_the_ark_of_the_covenant

pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, The Surrender of Breda — the keys of the beaten city handed over between the two armies with their lances standing behind them, the great King over all the earth, He subdues nations beneath us
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_the_surrender_of_breda

pictures.scene: Thomas Cole, View from Mount Holyoke — the whole valley and its river lying far below the rock the painter is standing on, and peoples under our feet, He chooses our inheritance for us
pictures.name: pd_cole_view_from_mount_holyoke_the_oxbow

pictures.scene: Aert de Gelder, Jacob's Dream — the sleeping man at the foot of the stair of light with the angels going up and down it, the pride of Jacob whom He loves, Selah
pictures.name: pd_de_gelder_jacobs_dream

pictures.scene: Pietro Perugino, The Ascension of Christ — the apostles standing in the field with their faces lifted as He is carried up above them on the cloud, God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD with the sound of the horn
pictures.name: pd_perugino_the_ascension_of_christ

pictures.scene: Hubert van Eyck, The Angels Playing Music — the angels at the organ with the harp and the viol beside it, sing praises to God sing praises, sing praises to our King sing praises
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_angels_playing_music

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Harvesters — the reapers resting under the pear tree in the middle of the cut corn with the sheaves standing around them, for God is King of all the earth, sing to Him a psalm of praise
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_the_harvesters

pictures.scene: Albrecht Dürer, The Adoration of the Trinity — the emperors and the popes and the kings of the nations kneeling together on the clouds with their hands joined, God reigns over the nations, God is seated on His holy throne
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_adoration_of_the_trinity

pictures.scene: Sandro Botticelli, The Adoration of the Magi — the lords of the train kneeling at the edge of the crowd while their horses are held behind them, the nobles of the nations have assembled, as the people of the God of Abraham
pictures.name: pd_botticelli_the_adoration_of_the_magi

pictures.scene: Paolo Uccello, The Battle of San Romano — the armoured horsemen locked together with the lances crossing over their heads, for the shields of the earth belong to God, He is highly exalted
pictures.name: pd_uccello_the_battle_of_san_romano

lines.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
Clap your hands, all you peoples;
shout unto God with a voice of triumph.
How awesome is the LORD Most High,
the great King over all the earth!
He subdues nations beneath us,
and peoples under our feet.
He chooses our inheritance for us,
the pride of Jacob, whom He loves.
Selah
God has ascended amid shouts of joy,
the LORD with the sound of the horn.
Sing praises to God, sing praises;
sing praises to our King, sing praises!
For God is King of all the earth;
sing to Him a psalm of praise.
God reigns over the nations;
God is seated on His holy throne.
The nobles of the nations have assembled
as the people of the God of Abraham;
for the shields of the earth belong to God;
He is highly exalted.
